value.rationale: The recently introduced default-delegation model motivates the mathematical question when participation uncertainty makes different cycle sizes strategically stable and socially desirable. Exact three-voter symmetric classification distinguishes strategic and socially optimal transitions at alpha, beta, gamma and demonstrates a nonempty interval where every equilibrium is inefficient despite symmetry, with an exact positive welfare penalty. This is a natural complete phase diagram and motivated structural boundary rather than a routine restatement of high-t sufficiency.
